# Saint Enterprise

> Saint Enterprise is a Harare, Zimbabwe studio that builds business websites, WhatsApp and website chatbots, and custom operational software for companies in Zimbabwe and abroad.

## Services
- [Website design](https://saintacademy.com/website-design-zimbabwe/): Mobile-first business websites from $80. Includes a custom design, a .com domain for the first year, hosting, SSL, branded business email, SEO basics and a 30-day warranty. Typically live in 3–5 business days once content is approved.
- [WhatsApp and web chatbots](https://saintacademy.com/whatsapp-chatbot-zimbabwe/): Chatbots on the WhatsApp Business Cloud API and on websites, from $150. They answer questions, take bookings and orders, capture leads, hand over to a person, and sync to Google Sheets, a CRM or email. Messaging fees are paid to Meta on the client's own account.
- [Operational software](https://saintacademy.com/business-software-zimbabwe/): Custom fleet desks, ledgers, client portals and live reports. Scoped and priced per project after a short consultation.

## Pricing
- Website: $80
- Chatbot: $150
- Care plan (hosting, updates, monitoring, backups): $35 per month
- Custom software: scoped per project

## Facts
- Location: Harare, Zimbabwe. Serves Zimbabwe and international clients.
- Contact: WhatsApp +263 78 876 2019, email saintsprinting1@gmail.com
- Ownership: clients own the source code, domain, hosting and accounts.
- Selected work: Truckana (fleet platform, truckana.com), FBK Forex Broker Killers (trading platform, fbktraders.com), Tobacco AI (leaf diagnosis on WhatsApp), ZIMSEC Maths (O-Level revision assistant on WhatsApp).
